Battelle to Develop INJECTABLE, BI-DIRECTIONAL BRAIN COMPUTER INTERFACE

Battelle has for years successfully demonstrated brain-computer interface (BCI) projects — just look at NeuroLife®, which has enabled a quadriplegic man to move his hand again using his thoughts. https://t.co/n51QSelGD5

Human-AI Communication bandwidth is the biggest bottleneck right now.

BCI is the eventual solution, but in the meantime, visualization is the way to go. https://t.co/MstGkHcvLH

BCI is the eventual solution, but in the mean times, visualization is the way to go. https://t.co/MstGkHcvLH

Neuralink says a trial participant hit 11.32 bits per second, a new BCI record. The stat I like more: some users went from 10 minutes of calibration a day to 10 minutes a week. That's what turns a lab device into something you just turn on.
